concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-managed-payouts]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms managed-payout schedule overview for local same-location/currency balance-account payouts, Adyen-contact configuration, settlement-delay limits and estimated ETAs.
warnings: One schedule per currency on a balance account; one location/currency per schedule; cross-country or cross-currency payouts are directed to custom payouts.

Managed schedules do not accelerate pass-through or T+7-plus sales-day settlement; ETA depends on cutoffs and contract, and weekly/monthly frequencies exclude the last one or two days before payout date.
A configured schedule, execution navigation or estimated arrival is not proof of a payout's final bank receipt; no failure/return lifecycle is defined on this overview.
